candidates.explanation: The component accesses the 'User.shared' singleton directly to retrieve the 'news' property, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or test.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Read access from main thread context.
Write access within a Task.detached block via MainActor.run.

candidates.explanation: The 'User.shared' singleton property 'news' is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (the main thread via 'needsUpdate' and within 'Task.detached' blocks via 'MainActor.run') without visible synchronization or actor isolation.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Task.detached captures 'currentLanguage' from the outer scope.

candidates.explanation: The 'restore' method uses 'Task.detached' to perform work that depends on 'currentLanguage' (a property of the 'Language' type), but the task is detached from the parent context and does not appear to have a justified independent lifetime.
candidates.title: Inappropriate Detached Task

candidates.explanation: The 'needsUpdate' property uses a force unwrap ('!') on the '.day' component of the date calculation without establishing a guarantee that the component is non-nil.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
